faultTypes.cracking: Visible cracks or splits; no inference about structural cause.
faultTypes.coating_deterioration: Peeling, missing, weathered or visibly incomplete paint/coating.
faultTypes.corrosion: Visible corrosion or rust deposits on metal.
faultTypes.material_loss: Visible erosion, holes, crumbling or loss of material; no hidden decay diagnosis.
faultTypes.joint_or_sealant_defect: Visible gaps, deterioration or incomplete finishing of joints/sealant.
faultTypes.damaged_component: Visible breakage, deformation or torn component.
faultTypes.displaced_component: Visibly shifted, misaligned or out-of-position component.
faultTypes.contamination: Visible debris, deposits or surface contamination; do not identify mould species.
faultTypes.moisture_staining: Visible staining associated in the source with moisture; does not establish active leakage.
faultTypes.standing_water: Visible ponding; does not establish duration or drainage performance.
faultTypes.unfinished_surface: Visible unfinished surface or missing finishing at an identifiable junction.

components.roof_flashing: Flashing, roof junctions and penetration seals.
components.roof_penetration: Chimneys, outlets, skylights and roof penetrations.
components.exterior_timber: External timber cladding, boards and trim, excluding window/door frames.
components.sanitary_fixture: Baths, shower trays, toilets and basins, including their immediate sealant junctions.
components.electrical_fitting: Visible switches and sockets; no electrical functionality judgment.

reviewScope: Every scored image is reviewed for all visible faults in this taxonomy. Absence of a report finding is never evidence of a negative.
descriptionScoring: Manual rubric only. Canonical tags measure structured identification, not the correctness of unrestricted prose.
